body:
Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ 69a9825257c550d44e48337248670677a3ddea7b

Verdict CLEAN
Findings: none.

Read the diff and issue #1431, including comments. Local merge with upstream/main 4f4edcf was already up to date.

Both named pins PASS: browser_theme_browse_is_disabled_with_a_reason and browser_fixture_file_rows_are_disabled_with_reasons.
Gate PASS: cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main. One step, zero failures; 800 tests passed, five ignored.
Clippy PASS: cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings. RUSTC_WRAPPER= was used.
Mutations: remove Theme's why.is_none() enabled guard -> RED; restore -> GREEN. Remove Fixtures' why.is_none() enabled guard -> RED; restore -> GREEN. Both fail on the disabled-state assertion. Restored tree is clean.

Extra case: a supported theme or colour-vision selection must still dispatch correctly after the interaction change. All five existing theme_door tests PASS. No new machining, collision or G-code path was found in this diff. No wasm compilation or browser session was run.

Rules checked: no added unwrap/expect/panic outside tests; no golden, snapshot PNG, PROCESS_VERSION, dependency, .github or scripts changes. Changelog: and Fixes #1431 are present. New test module is 61 lines; production files are 162 and 140 lines. Existing structural.rs grows from 585 to 588 lines only to register the child module; it remains above the approximate size guideline.

Fixed the release-notes finding in b706db9c726bbc082fa8819cb1fb0747ef251219.

Restored RELEASE_NOTES.md from upstream/main. Removed the release-note correction claim from the decision file and PR body.

Pin: /tmp/pr1687-release-notes-pin.py checks notes equality and absence of both claims. Restoring each local file to the reviewed head made its assertion fail. Restoring the fix made it pass. This is a temporary documentation check; no repository test was added.

Quick gate passed: 800 tests passed, 5 ignored, zero failures. UI clippy passed with -D warnings.

Please re-review the new head. The PR remains a draft.

Antigravity pre-review (Claude Opus 5.5 via Antigravity; not a collaborator review; no marker) @ b706db9c726bbc082fa8819cb1fb0747ef251219

**Verdict: CLEAN**

I ran this on the PR head plus a local merge of upstream/main (5992bab). The merge was clean.

**Tests, gate, clippy**
- Pins `browser_theme_browse_is_disabled_with_a_reason` and `browser_fixture_file_rows_are_disabled_with_reasons`: both pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green. 1 step, 0 failed. ui lib: 776 passed, 5 ignored. boundary, boundary_picks, sinker_setup and theme_files all pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Mutations** (I reverted one guard at a time, ran the pins, then restored it)
- theme_drop.rs:110 `live && why.is_none()` changed to `live`: RED. Browse is not disabled in the browser.
- theme_drop.rs:106 `if state.browser_build` guard removed: RED. Browse becomes disabled on desktop.
- fixture_menu.rs:106 `cmd.is_some() && why.is_none()` changed to `cmd.is_some()`: RED.
- fixture_menu.rs:104 `state.browser_build.then(..)` changed to always refuse: RED. The rows become disabled on desktop.
- fixture_menu.rs:112 `on_disabled_hover_text` dropped: RED. The test reports "Import fixture… explains its refusal".
- After restoring all five, both pins are green again.

**AGENTS.md checks**
- No new unwrap, expect or panic outside tests.
- Touched files are small: fixture_menu.rs is 140 lines, theme_drop.rs 162, the new test file 61. structural.rs only gains the 3-line `mod` include.
- No goldens moved. The body says "None".
- No snapshot PNG, PROCESS_VERSION, Cargo, .github or scripts changes.
- The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1431`. The decision file is present.

**Non-blocking notes**
- fixture_menu.rs:103 and theme_drop.rs:105 repeat `State::browser_refusal_of` (state_browser.rs:31) inline, with `per_op` hard-coded to `false`. This makes no difference for these commands today. Calling the helper would keep one source of truth.
- The body says the fresh verification ran at 69a9825. The head is now b706db9, but that commit only changes docs (RELEASE_NOTES.md revert, decision file). The code is the same.
- `Fixes #1431` will close the issue. One item in the issue's "Done means" is "the release notes' known issue is removed". That edit was dropped on purpose (the notes are already released). The cut should carry it.

**Uncovered case I checked**
- This change is UI only. It cannot gouge or post G-code.
- Clicks and the keyboard cannot reach a disabled row. In egui 0.36, `hovered()` and `clicked()` are always false for disabled widgets. The theme path also checks `&& live`.
- Command dispatch still refuses the same commands as a backstop. The table test in browser_files.rs covers that.
- Rows that are supported (built-in vise, accessory, plate, "Use as fixture", the theme pick rows, the colour-vision rows) stay live, because `refusal` returns None for them.
- I found no failing case.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b706db9c726bbc082fa8819cb1fb0747ef251219 -->
**Delta review @ b706db9c (M5): clean, `merge-ready`.**

The review of 69a98252 asked for one change: remove the edit to `RELEASE_NOTES.md`. Commit b706db9c does this. The PR no longer changes `RELEASE_NOTES.md` against main. The commit also removes the matching sentence from `docs/decisions/1431-browser-menu-refusals.md`. No code changed in the delta. A pre-review on this head (Claude Opus 5.5 via Antigravity) is clean. The code review of 69a98252 stands: native builds keep the items enabled, and browser builds disable them with a reason. The ui lib suites and clippy were green.

A release cut is open (PR #1694). This PR merges after the tag.
